data.name: Signature Wand
data.description: A counterfeit mage can spend 1 hour practicing with a wand to designate it as his signature wand. He can draw that wand as a free action, and can activate it without having to succeed at a Use Magic Device check. He can change his signature wand once per day.

raw_tokens.value: Counterfeit Mage Class Feature.Rogue Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

A counterfeit mage can spend 1 hour practicing with a wand to designate it as his signature wand. He can draw that wand as a free action, and can activate it without having to succeed at a Use Magic Device check. He can change his signature wand once per day.
